annotations.title: Desk notes: short dated observations the ByKaranteli desk wrote from its own recorded derivatives data

description: Call this when the user asks what happened in crypto derivatives today or on a date, what the desk observed, what moved in funding, open interest, liquidations, options, ETF flows or exchange premiums, or wants a dated, quotable sentence with its number and time. Returns the desk's notes newest first: each is one observation written by the desk writer (an AI model) from the platform's own recorded data and checked against it before publishing, with its publish time in UTC, the card's data time, the desk's 0 to 10 news value, the board it read from, the coins it names and its permanent URL. Information about the data, never advice. Default the newest 25 notes of the last 24 hours (count says how many came back; limit up to 100 for more); pass day for one UTC day, since for a window up to 7 days back (50 notes unless limit says otherwise), type for one card type (funding-arb, liqmap-btc, event-liq-burst, ...), lang for zh, ru or ko text. Pass detail "compact" for a shorter page or "full" for the whole answer.

detail.description: Optional. "compact": a shorter page than the default (fewer rows, newest points kept, rounded figures, long text cut, grids left out; every cut named in trimmed). "full" or true: the whole route answer, still under the 100,000 character ceiling (the largest boards answer the ceiling note then: narrow them with symbol, limit or days instead). Omitted or false: the default first page.

lang.description: Text language (default en); a note without that translation comes back in English

limit.description: Notes to return, 1..100 (default 25 for the last 24 hours, 50 with day or since)

since.description: ISO time; notes published at or after it, at most 7 days back (ignored with day)

type.description: One card type, e.g. funding-arb, liqmap-btc, event-liq-burst
